title: Bank application: staff review it before it goes out (Reviewed, Submit, Send back)
text: A bank application a client sends in is no longer emailed on its own. It waits under Calendar > Applications to review and on the Forms page; staff press Reviewed, then Submit to the bank contact after a confirmation box that shows exactly what leaves and where. Send back to client makes a new one-time link and emails the client a note, or Create link only to share it yourself. Only the owner can change the two address settings on the Forms card.
points: Undo send back cancels the new link and restores the application, while nobody has opened the new link.
Staff are notified with "Bank application RESUBMITTED" when a client sends back a corrected application.
On the client form the Seminole shipping address is just a heading and three lines; the client never sees where the application goes.
iPhone photos are named by what is stored (.jpg); if a Submit may not have reached Gmail, staff are asked to check Sent mail first.
